newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Capital Q4 full results.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Capital Q4 full results.

text.p: Loss from write downs of assets and settlement

NOTE: Consolidated Capital North America Inc said its net loss for fiscal year 1996 included $213,672 for the writedown of the assets amd a loss in the buyout of certain stock options of $11,400 resulting when the company issued 28,500 common shares o cancel options covering 35,000 common Shares.

The company also said that a subsidiary, Consolidated Land & Cattle Co, merged with Angeles Acquisition Corp. Pro forma net loss includes $600,000 from certain pro-forma adjustments in connection with the Angeles acquisition.
The company was not available to discuss why it did not report comparable figures.
